verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents vector-store destinations, embedding or chunking, or LLM-ready output formats for synced data. The nearby items cover other capabilities: Airbyte Agents and MCP give live data access, PyAirbyte loads into caches, and the destinations named are warehouses, lakes and databases. None of these show pipelines loading into vector stores, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, pipelines load into vector stores and LLM-ready formats so my agents can retrieve what was synced
